title: Koala holding a balloon
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- balloon string -->
  <path d='M62 30 Q66 45 60 60' stroke='#d9d9e8' stroke-width='1.5' fill='none'/>
  <!-- balloon -->
  <ellipse cx='63' cy='22' rx='11' ry='13' fill='#ff4d6d'/>
  <ellipse cx='63' cy='22' rx='7' ry='9' fill='#ff8fa3'/>
  <ellipse cx='59' cy='17' rx='3' ry='4' fill='#ffd0d9'/>
  <path d='M63 35 l-3 4 l6 0 z' fill='#c9184a'/>
  <!-- koala body -->
  <ellipse cx='42' cy='72' rx='20' ry='22' fill='#8fa9c9'/>
  <ellipse cx='42' cy='76' rx='13' ry='15' fill='#b8cfe6'/>
  <!-- arm holding string -->
  <ellipse cx='58' cy='62' rx='6' ry='9' fill='#7a93b3' transform='rotate(35 58 62)'/>
  <ellipse cx='60' cy='57' rx='5' ry='6' fill='#8fa9c9'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <circle cx='42' cy='40' r='19' fill='#8fa9c9'/>
  <!-- ears -->
  <circle cx='24' cy='32' r='10' fill='#8fa9c9'/>
  <circle cx='24' cy='32' r='5.5' fill='#d5b8d8'/>
  <circle cx='60' cy='32' r='10' fill='#8fa9c9'/>
  <circle cx='60' cy='32' r='5.5' fill='#d5b8d8'/>
  <!-- face light area -->
  <ellipse cx='42' cy='46' rx='13' ry='11' fill='#b8cfe6'/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx='36' cy='40' r='2.6' fill='#2b2b4a'/>
  <circle cx='48' cy='40' r='2.6' fill='#2b2b4a'/>
  <circle cx='36.8' cy='39' r='0.9' fill='#e8f0ff'/>
  <circle cx='48.8' cy='39' r='0.9' fill='#e8f0ff'/>
  <!-- nose -->
  <ellipse cx='42' cy='47' rx='4.5' ry='3.6' fill='#3d3d5c'/>
  <ellipse cx='42' cy='46' rx='1.6' ry='1.2' fill='#c9d6ea'/>
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d='M38 52 Q42 55 46 52' stroke='#5a7396' stroke-width='1.4' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- feet -->
  <ellipse cx='32' cy='93' rx='8' ry='4' fill='#7a93b3'/>
  <ellipse cx='52' cy='93' rx='8' ry='4' fill='#7a93b3'/>
</svg>
